messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children"
set: ["keep all pens, vials, needles, and syringes out of reach of children", "keep out of the reach of children", "keep out of the reach of children and pets", "keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "dispose of used pens, needles, and syringes in an approved sharps container", "keep out of light", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "all of these conditions", "at least 2% of children and teenagers", "children 6 years of age and older", "children 2 years of age and older", "children of any age", "keep on hand at all times", "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "keep with you at all times"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
